sources.title: Granite 4.1 | IBM Granite
sources.snippet: Granite 4.1 Dense language model family in 3B, 8B, and 30B sizes with instruction-tuned variants, delivering improved tool calling, instruction following, coding, and mathematical reasoning.

sources.title: IBM Granite 4.1: The 8B Model That Matches 32B Performance (2026)
sources.snippet: The headline number: the 8B dense model matches or beats the previous Granite 4.0-H-Small, a 32B Mixture-of-Experts model with 9B active parameters. That is a 4× parameter reduction with no performance loss. All three sizes — 3B, 8B, and 30B — ship under Apache 2.0, are cryptographically signed, and support up to 512K tokens of context.
